title: Family tab, one parent
note: The one lit room, low and still. "Who writes to Asha", and the people as signatures, "From Mama" with "You" under it: no avatar, no initials, no email address, nothing counted. While the book has one parent, the invite card with the closed cover, and the privacy line says who the book is shared with, never who can read it (S57, review A1). Before sign-in, the invite sheet asks for sign-in first and comes back to the invite.
